reason: I'd use the free first visit and probably pay for one drop-in a month when I need to get a little work done with my toddler occupied. Anything more than once or twice a month is hard on our budget, so a membership is out.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, so a membership or pack doesn't pay off, and $13 per visit plus a snack adds up fast on our income.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper weekday-morning drop-in, or a pack that doesn't expire so I can use it a visit at a time.
